fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-10-24
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-23 11:30 to 2026-10-24 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: one, still open.
- bf4a5af5 (filed 10-22 00:14, about 59h old, still a draft): may the diagnostics lists on about 16 command results change from plain text to objects (srs-rust#1264)? Why it matters: every current reader (srs-web, srs-vscode, scripts, MCP clients) breaks on the day the new build is pinned. Options: (A) replace everywhere in one release; (B) add a structured list beside the text one, retire the text later; (C) code on validation results first, other surfaces later; (D) do nothing. Recommendation: C first, then B. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium. Your 10-24 ruling on c7fefad9 (settle #1264 first) makes this the next blocker.
Also waiting on you: the exercise dd1a47a7 (should relation reads carry createdBy, notes and meta, srs-rust#1411; recommendation yes, additive). Unchanged and still needs-input: srs-rust#861, #683, #1198, #1339, #1342, srs#236. Label step from your c7fefad9 ruling: srs-rust#1264 still carries needs-input; the ruling's next step (label it ready) is not done.

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified by the group this cycle. Owner rulings this cycle: c7fefad9 "Diagnostics shape before srs-rust#1339" accepted in your 10-24 11:03 session (settle #1264 first, #1339 follows); the session also received the 10-22 and 10-23 reports. srs-vscode#145's quorum comment names a decision ("Keep container entry order and drop the relation list call, rather than adding a core binding": assent) but no such record exists in the group log, so there is nothing to ratify; see section 4.

3. Done: 2 PRs merged.
- srs-vscode#145 (section order from container entry order): builder agent:tpr-builder / reviewer agent:tpr-reviewer / mandate 00567bf1/R6+RFC-043, approve on green head 71cb07e; gate:auto-merge, merged 11:04 UTC.
- srs-rust#1440 (RFC-052, dataModelRevision 10): builder human:the-greenman / reviewer agent:tpr-reviewer / mandate RFC-052/practice-decision-a8e833f1, approve on green head 24bca22b; gate:owner-merge, merged 10-23 11:54 UTC by you.

4. Stuck or lost: open group PR: srs-rust#1462 (fix for #1442, opened 11:25, branch behind base, no quorum comment yet; no reviewer verdict, so nothing to merge). The srs-vscode#145 decision named above was never recorded as a proposed decision by the builder; the PR merged anyway, so the choice is in effect with no record. Every merged PR this cycle has a quorum line. needs-input: srs-rust#861, #683, #1198, #1264, #1339, #1342, srs#236.

5. Budget: 1 of 10 delegated merges this cycle (srs-vscode#145; srs-rust#1440 was owner-merge and does not count); 1 open. clerk group-state read 0 merged because this run started after the 11:30 roll-over; the figure here is counted from the PRs. Pause state: running (the 10-23 report carries a thumbs-up).
5b. Awaiting ratification: bf4a5af5 (still draft, about 59h; worth a look, it is not yet proposed). Nothing else pending. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready and workable: 4 (srs-rust#1132, #1412, #1445, srs-web#578, all P2; srs-rust#1132 now has its Answers line). In progress: srs-rust#1442 (P1) via PR #1462. Ready but stopped (needs-input or parked): srs-rust#1339, #1342, #1198, #861, #704, #683. Top 3 in the Builder's order, no local priorities set: srs-rust#1132, srs-rust#1412, srs-web#578. Open group PRs in flight: 1. Budget left: 9. Queue running dry: 4 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding: your ruling on bf4a5af5 releases #1264 and then #1339; after that the analyst's nominations and the drift list. Waiting on you: bf4a5af5, dd1a47a7 and the items in section 1. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-23 12:15 run: filed 1, nominated 3, grounded 1, exercises 1.

6b. Exercises: two open, both the group's own (not listed in the SemanticOps log): "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable: RFC-038 [R7]+[R24] against rfc-decision-2e0cd70a" (2ac083c0), input asked for: non-fatal diagnostic or fail-closed with the LOAD verb narrowed to meta; and "Relation reads hide who asserted a link" (dd1a47a7), input asked for: should relation list and context reads carry createdBy, notes and meta (srs-rust#1411).

7. What we learned: your 10-24 session cleared the backlog in one pass (two reports received, one escalation accepted), so the loop from escalation to ruling took about 35h and the pause never triggered. Two lessons: the builder's quorum comment can name a decision that has no record, so the assent has nothing to ratify (check for the record before merging, or have the reviewer name the record id); and group-state resets at 11:30, so a close that runs late reads zero merges. Build trigger: ratified decisions across both logs are well over 10, so srs-web#560 (decision-log lens) is still ready to unpark; flagged again.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation record was filed: the one item outside the boundary (the shape of structured diagnostics, srs-rust#1264) is already open as bf4a5af5, and the owner accepted c7fefad9 this cycle. The vscode#145 decision named in its quorum comment has no record, which is a process gap and not an escalation.
